callouts.label: Substance Impairment
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents substance impairment.
callouts.description: Alcohol, cannabis, some medicines, and other drugs can impair driving.
callouts.ap_tip: Feeling okay does not prove safe driving ability. Mixing substances increases uncertainty.

callouts.label: Attention
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents attention.
callouts.description: Impairment can narrow, divide, or disrupt attention.
callouts.ap_tip: Driving requires monitoring several things at once. Distraction and impairment can compound risk.

callouts.label: Reaction Time
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents reaction time.
callouts.description: Impairment can slow the time between noticing a hazard and responding.
callouts.ap_tip: Road conditions leave little margin for delay. No trick instantly restores safe reaction time.

callouts.label: Judgment
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents judgment.
callouts.description: Impairment can increase confidence while reducing accurate risk assessment.
callouts.ap_tip: Plans made before substance use are more reliable. Do not negotiate with an impaired driver.

callouts.label: Passenger Influence
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents passenger influence.
callouts.description: Passengers can increase pressure or help stop an unsafe trip.
callouts.ap_tip: Speak up early and recruit others. Do not get into a vehicle with an impaired driver.

callouts.label: Seatbelts
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents seatbelts.
callouts.description: Every occupant should use a seatbelt on every trip.
callouts.ap_tip: Seatbelts reduce injury risk but do not make impaired driving safe. Choose the correct restraint for the rider.

callouts.label: Alternate Ride
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents alternate ride.
callouts.description: Use a sober driver, caregiver, taxi or rideshare, transit, or a safe place to stay.
callouts.ap_tip: Plan options and payment before an event. A temporary inconvenience is safer than an impaired trip.

callouts.label: Hold the Keys Safely
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents hold the keys safely.
callouts.description: A sober friend or adult may help prevent access to a vehicle when it can be done safely.
callouts.ap_tip: Avoid physical confrontation. Get adult or emergency help if the person may drive anyway.

callouts.label: Community and Legal Consequences
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents community and legal consequences.
callouts.description: Impaired driving can harm people and bring school, family, financial, and legal consequences.
callouts.ap_tip: Laws vary by jurisdiction. Prevention focuses on safety, not shame.

callouts.label: Emergency Response
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents emergency response.
callouts.description: Call emergency services for a crash, unresponsive person, breathing danger, or immediate threat on the road.
callouts.ap_tip: Give location and vehicle information when safe. Do not follow or confront dangerously.
